name: LayoutGlut – PDF, Doc, Excel, Image and more File preview for WooCommerce
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
Selling ebooks, templates, worksheets, spreadsheets, sheet music or courses? LayoutGlut adds a preview of your files to WooCommerce products, so customers can look inside before they buy.

Where previews show

  • Product page: choose a Page design — the whole product page (gallery with images and files, price, buy box, file list and description) laid out as one design, then fine-tune colors, fonts and layout in the Page Builder. Block themes keep their own page and get the file gallery in place of the product image
  • Shop, category, tag and search pages: a “Preview” button (button, icon or link) on each product card that opens a popup
  • Anywhere: the [layoutglut_preview] shortcode
  • Classic and block themes

What can be previewed

  • PDF, Word (DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF), Excel (XLS, XLSX, ODS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX, ODP) and text files — Word (DOCX) and Excel (XLSX, CSV) in the browser; the rest through the Google Docs viewer
  • Images, video and audio — with the built-in viewer

Per product

A “File Preview” box on the product edit screen: pick the product’s downloadable files, a file from the media library (for example a free sample) or a link; label, order and switch each one on or off; show or hide previews for one product.

Admin

  • Preview Files: every product with previews, file types, what is not shown and why, quick on / off switches
  • Global Settings: page design, popup or inline viewer, button style and text, colors, custom CSS
  • Page Builder: customize the chosen page design with a live preview
  • Tools: system status, export / import, reset, delete all

Good to know

The Google Docs viewer has to download the file from your site, so documents only preview on a site that is reachable from the internet, and only for files with a public URL (not files in the protected WooCommerce downloads folder — upload a sample to the media library instead). Images, video and audio work everywhere.

LayoutGlut Pro renders PDF (PDF.js), Word (DOCX) and Excel (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV) on your own site through signed, expiring links, works on local and private sites and with protected files, and adds preview limits for non-buyers with a buy box, watermarks, copy protection, buyer and role access rules, previews in My Account › Downloads and preview analytics.

External services

This plugin uses the Google Docs Viewer (docs.google.com) to show PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text files in the free version.

  • What is sent: when a visitor opens such a preview, their browser loads https://docs.google.com/gview with the public URL of that preview file. Google then downloads the file from your site to display it. The visitor’s browser connects to Google, so Google receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details.
  • When: only when a visitor opens a preview of one of those file types. Nothing is sent on page load, and nothing is sent for images, video or audio, which are shown by the browser directly.
  • Files in the protected WooCommerce downloads folder are never sent.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms — Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the layoutglut folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Edit a product and add files in the File Preview — LayoutGlut box.
  3. Pick a page design in LayoutGlut › Global Settings › Product Page, and fine-tune it in the Page Builder tab.
sections.faq:
The PDF / Word preview stays blank

The Google Docs viewer cannot reach local sites (localhost, .local, .test) or files behind a login. Check LayoutGlut › Tools › System status. Use a public sample file, or LayoutGlut Pro for on-site rendering.

Can customers download the file from the preview?

Files in the WooCommerce protected folder are never given out by the free plugin. Media library files you add as samples are public files, like any media file.

Does it work with my theme?

Previews are added with standard WooCommerce hooks and blocks. If your theme prints its own product cards, the shop button attaches to the add to cart button; the shortcode works anywhere.
sections.changelog:
3.2.0

  • The Position setting is removed from Product Page settings: the product page is laid out by the chosen Page design (classic themes); block themes show the file gallery in place of the product image.
  • Product Page settings simplified: no separate Design heading, tab title, tab order or gallery options.
  • Readme and help texts updated for page designs and the Page Builder.

3.1.2

  • Admin screens use the new pink accent color to match the LayoutGlut logo.

3.1.1

  • New LayoutGlut logo in the admin header and menu, matching the WordPress.org plugin icon.

3.1.0

  • New Page Builder with ready-made preview page designs (5 in the free plugin, 20 with Pro) and a template picker.
  • Word (DOCX) and Excel files can be previewed in the browser using the bundled Mammoth and SheetJS libraries.
  • Improved free-version file preview and File Preview box on products.
  • Extension API refinements for LayoutGlut Pro and add-ons.

3.0.1

  • New plugin icon, banner and screenshots.
  • The Save settings button is easier to read in the admin header.
  • Readme wording improvements.

3.0.0

  • Rebuilt as a WooCommerce file preview plugin.
  • Product tab / section, shop and archive buttons, popup and inline viewer, shortcode.
  • File Preview box on products; Preview Files, Global Settings and Tools screens.
  • Extension API for LayoutGlut Pro and add-ons (see EXTENDING.md).

upgrade_notice.3.2.0: The product page is now set by the Page design only: the old "Position" setting (tab, below add to cart, above / below tabs) is removed. Choose a page design in Global Settings › Product Page.
upgrade_notice.3.1.2: The admin screens now use the LayoutGlut pink accent color. No action needed.
upgrade_notice.3.1.1: New logo and admin menu icon matching the plugin icon. No action needed.
upgrade_notice.3.1.0: Adds the Page Builder with ready-made preview page designs and in-browser Word / Excel viewing. No action needed.
upgrade_notice.3.0.1: Small improvements and new screenshots, icon and banner. No action needed.
upgrade_notice.3.0.0: LayoutGlut is now a file preview plugin. The product, shop and archive page layouts of version 1.x are removed; your theme's WooCommerce templates are used again.
